CreatePlatformTypeList

The CreatePlatformTypeList method creates or copies a platform type list. 
ODPlatformTypeList CreatePlatformTypeList (
                           in ODPlatformTypeList typeList);
typeList
A reference to the platform type list to be duplicated, or kODNULL to create an empty platform type list.
return value
A reference to the newly created platform type list.
DISCUSSION
Your part calls this method.

SEE ALSO
The ODPlatformTypeList class (page 564).
